text: The newest iPhones, ChatGPT, every top AI... none of it exists without one machine!
One machine? What if it broke?
No new AI chips. No new iPhones. And only one company on Earth can build it.
ASML, in a small Dutch town called Veldhoven.
Why can't anyone else make it?
Because it fires a laser at falling drops of tin, fifty thousand times a second!
Each flash is hotter than the surface of the Sun. That light draws circuits thousands of times thinner than a hair.
Its mirrors are so smooth that, blown up to the size of Germany, the biggest bump would be a tenth of a millimetre.
More than half work for TSMC in Taiwan, the company that makes Nvidia's AI chips.
Not one. In twenty nineteen, under pressure from Washington, the Dutch let China's licence lapse.
That's why China has to build its best chips with older machines, and why the whole AI race runs through one Dutch town.
Like, follow History Sketches, and tell us what we should map next!
None of it exists without one machine.
